Subject: Contract bridge playbook & first-pass MAP (BW-3245)

Hi Jared / Priya —

Great talking yesterday. Per our call I attached a lightweight mutual action plan (Bluewell_MAP_v1.xlsx) that aligns the evaluation milestones to the procurement/legal checkpoints we discussed. Key asks up front:

- Confirm target pilot start: week of 3/15 (expected)
- Procurement priority: do you need DPA agreed before PO? (helps us sequence the order form)
- Any internal acceptance testing dates we should align to (SLA/uptime or data handling thumbs)?

High-level MAP milestones I put in the sheet:
1) Legal review (DPA + MSA redlines) — target 2 weeks after we receive redlines
2) SOC2 evidence exchange — we can share our report + questionnaire responses this week (see stub attached)
3) Order form/PO execution — ideally after DPA signature, unless procurement confirms they can issue PO subject to DPA in progress
4) Pilot kickoff — weekend provisioning window we use for low-latency inference tests

I'll loop in Karthik (solutions) and Laura (legal) to triage redlines quickly. If you can, drop any procurement-specific constraints into the MAP sheet so we can update.

Attachments: Bluewell_MAP_v1.xlsx, Bluewell_SOC2_Report_stub.pdf

Thanks —

Marissa —

Thanks for the MAP. A couple things from procurement:

- We generally require a signed DPA before issuing a formal PO for pilot spend.
- For healthcare data handling we need the full SOC2 report (redacted is OK) and a completed security questionnaire by 1/29 to make budget cycles.
- We can accept an order form with a conditional signature if legal confirms the DPA will be signed within 7 business days of PO.

Can you confirm Redwood can commit to that cadence? Also looping Jared to confirm internal stakeholders for acceptance testing.

Best —
Priya
Senior Procurement Manager | Bluewell Health

- We can prioritize the DPA review as time-critical; our legal SLA for first-pass redlines is 3 business days from receipt.
- SOC2 report: attached stub earlier; will provide the full redacted PDF by end of day tomorrow.
- Conditional PO approach is workable — we'll accept PO subject to DPA signature within 7 business days, provided legal confirms no material changes.

Laura — can you confirm you'll take point on DPA redlines? Karthik — can you share an acceptance checklist for pilot testing that Priya can consume? Vanessa — I'd like to flag this as a near-term close for the quarter, may need a small onboarding credit if legal/PO timing slips.

I'll pull the updates into the MAP and re-share.

Marissa / team / Bluewell —

Attached are our proposed redlines for the MSA and a DPA that aligns to healthcare data processing needs (see Redlines_RI_MSA_v2026-01-19.pdf). Highlights:

- Data processing: we accept Bluewell's minimum encryption and breach notification windows; proposed narrower data retention clause to match pilot requirements.
- Liability: standard carveouts preserved; we propose cap tied to pilot fees (we can discuss for production).
- Subprocessors: full transparency + 30-day notice; we commit to an internal inventory link.
- Signature cadence: we can turn around a final DPA signature within 3 business days after we receive any Bluewell counter-redlines.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Bluewell submits any counter-redlines by EOD Wed 1/21.
2) Redwood will finalize DPA by Fri 1/23 and share for signature (DocuSign).
3) Procurement to issue conditional PO once DPA in-process (per Priya's note).

Attachments: Redlines_RI_MSA_v2026-01-19.pdf

Laura Bennett
